_comment: Layout versions (stage 8, plans/layout-iteracion-1.md). The only place that decides which layout the skill uses. v0 is the frozen TFM layout; every candidate is the TFM harness with some render modules swapped (tools/layout-lab/harness/). Harness paths are relative to the engine root. Change the default only with the user's approval.
defaultDecision: User, 2026-09-26: v20 (v16 + v12 fixed bpmn-auto-layout + v13 flow clarity + proposal H flow labels off shapes) made the default after winning its vote against v16 10-0 (1 tie, p = 0.002); it fails the objective gate against v16 only on v12's area (find-a-job, c-syn015-gemini, both preferred by the user) and 1 label case. Previous defaults: v16 (2026-09-26; won 2-0 against v15), v15 (2026-09-26; won 12-1 against v7), v7 (2026-09-26; won 16-6 against v6), v6 (2026-09-26), v4 (2026-09-25).

v0.description: TFM layout (frozen engine f558eb0, apps/tfm-lab headless harness). Parity and corpus checks always use it.

v1.description: v0 + own bpmn-auto-layout pass per pool (idea A): replaces the layout-missing stride for pools 2+, stride kept as fallback for unreachable nodes; all later phases are v0

v2.description: v1 + vertical pool order minimising pools crossed by message flows (idea B); ties keep the DSL order

v3.description: v2 + per-pool horizontal shift aligning message flow ends (idea C); frames keep a common left edge. Lost the vote in both views.

v4.description: v2 + title bands kept clear (idea E1): all pool/lane frames widened left by the deepest intrusion of any shape or (estimated) label into a title band; nothing else moves

v5.description: v4 + label-aware artifact placement: data object/store names and other elements' external labels count as footprint/obstacles, annotations sized to their text, associations may not leave through their artifact's name; v0 rules as fallback

v6.description: v5 with artifact rules tuned from the user's notes: straight associations for near artifacts (bend on a route < 250 px costs 250), soft air (shape within 12 px costs 100), same-name artifacts in a pool pulled together when within 350 px

v7.description: v6 + common pool width (every pool and its lanes reach the widest pool's right edge) and lanes filling their pool (no empty strip above the first lane or below the last); frames only grow, nothing else moves

v8.description: v7 + proposal C: v6 artifact rules without cohesion and with a reach limit (each px of an association beyond 250 px costs 1 more), so air no longer pushes artifacts away from their node

v9.description: v7 + proposal G: an event name goes above the event when the default box below collides with shapes, flows, associations or labels and above collides less (and stays in its lane)

v10.description: v7 + proposal D: tasks as wide as their longest word needs (12 px Arial, 7 px padding), widened right after the per-pool auto-layout; the rest of the process shifts right

v11.description: v7 + proposal B: while an artifact has no clean spot, open a band under the row of its first linked node (everything below moves down) and place again; at most 6 rounds

v12.description: v7 + proposal A: bpmn-auto-layout 0.5.0 with Grid.addAfter fixed (vendored in the harness): a node takes the next free cell instead of being spliced into its row, which pushed row tails such as gateways to the far right; an occupied cell opens a column in every row

v13.description: v7 + flow clarity after the channel distribution: a node face keeps one direction (a flow of the other direction is re-routed through a free face) and flows that share neither source nor target no longer share a stretch of line (segment shifted sideways or flow re-routed; crossings allowed, merges not)

v14.description: v7 + v10 + v11 + v9, the clear winners of the v8-v12 votes, unchanged: tasks as wide as their longest word, bands opened for artifacts without a clean spot, then event names raised above when below collides (last, on the final geometry)

v15.description: v14 with one change to v11's rule (user's note on c-syn015-gemini): a band opened for an artifact stays only if it changes where some artifact goes; a band that changes no placement is undone

v16.description: v15 + v9's rule for data objects and stores: the name goes above the shape when the default box below collides with shapes, flows, associations or labels and above collides less (and stays in its lane); after v15's event pass

v17.description: v16 + v13's flow clarity after the channel distribution: a node face keeps one direction and flows sharing neither source nor target no longer share a stretch of line

v18.description: v16 + v12 (bpmn-auto-layout 0.5.0 with Grid.addAfter fixed, vendored in harness/v12) + v13 (flow clarity)

v19.description: v16 + proposal H: a flow label whose drawn text (11 px Arial, measured) covers a shape slides along its stretch of line, or to the other side, to the spot that covers fewest shapes, then labels, then lines

v20.description: v18 + v19, the winners of the votes against v16 (v17 2-0, v18 6-0, v19 4-0), unchanged: v16 + v12 (fixed bpmn-auto-layout) + v13 (flow clarity) + proposal H (flow labels off shapes)

v21.description: v20 + untangling (user's note on c-syn015-chatgpt): v13's flow-clarity router also re-routes flows that cross another, looking for fewer crossings (80 rounds); a route over the default name box of an event or gateway, or leaving no room for its own name, costs 400; last, a boundary event's name moves beside its exit line when that line crosses it

v22.description: v20 + compact lanes: before pools and lanes are stacked, each lane drops the grid rows only other lanes use (a gap wider than one 140 px row loses the excess from its middle); flows are re-routed by the later phases

v23.description: v21 tuned from its vote (11-7): flows sharing neither source nor target that run parallel closer than 10 px count as merged there, and the router no longer guesses a gateway's name below it nor counts the names of a flow's own ends (later passes move them)
